messages:
maya: Quick ping — I'm running a short sanity sweep on the token-cost telemetry after last night's schema change. Can folks owning downstream consumers confirm nothing critical is broken?

sanjay: Thanks — what's the scope? Is this just event rename (token_count -> tokens) or the new cost_fields addition too?

maya: Both. Primary changes: renamed token_count -> tokens, added cost.{unit,currency,model_version} and a top-level sample_rate. The canonical event is `token_usage.v2`.

kevin: I saw a small spike in missing `model_version` for a handful of requests in the logs. Could be an SDK edge case. I can audit the last 2 hours.

elaine: We'll need to update the billing pipeline mapping step. I'm pausing the nightly roll until we confirm. Blocking PR is #4216.

maya: Filing quick checklist: 1) smoke ingest (dev stack), 2) compare token totals to v1 on same traces, 3) validate cost math matches cost-service. Who wants 1/2/3?

sanjay: I can run smoke ingest (1) on dev. ETA 30–40m.

kevin: I'll do the cost math comparison (3) once you dump the dev sample. If sample_rate is applied, remember to scale counts by 1/sample_rate.

elaine: I'll hold the billing mapping change in staging and run the mapping diff. If results look good, I'll cut a PR to prod mapping with a canary flag.

billing-bot: deploy-notice: billing-worker v2.3 queued; holding due to label `block:token-schema-check`.

maya: Thanks. Sanjay — when you run smoke ingest, please grab a small trace set and run this SQL to compare tokens: ```SELECT sum(tokens) AS tot_tokens, count(distinct request_id) AS reqs FROM dev_token_usage WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '2 hours';```

kevin: Also run the v1 dump: ```SELECT sum(token_count) AS tot_tokens FROM prod_token_usage_v1 WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '2 hours' AND request_id IN (<dev_sample_ids>);``` I'll join numbers.

maya: One more note — if sample_rate != 1, include the `sample_rate` field in the export. Many sources default to 0.1.

elaine: FYI dependency list: audit-log team (for request_id parity), billing (me), data-warehouse (sanjay), runtime-sdk (kevin).

kevin: Found the SDK edge: python client v1.8.0 doesn't populate model_version when model alias used. Drafting quick patch.

maya: Great. If anyone hits weird gaps post-check, tag me and I'll coordinate rollback of the rename (we can fall back to v1 endpoint for 1 hour).

elaine: Update — ran mapping diff, produced expected numbers for 95% of traces. Two outliers where tokens doubled; investigating root cause.

kevin: Those outliers were requests with streaming + chunked attachments; our tokenization ran twice on a retry path. Pushing a fix to dedupe token accounting.

maya: Awesome. Plan: kevin patch -> smoke re-run -> billing staging mapping apply -> compare totals -> unblock billing-worker. Targeting unblock by EOD.

sanjay: Smoke ingest done. Dev totals: tot_tokens=1,452,120, reqs=14,780, sample_rate=0.1. Exported sample ids to /tmp/token-sample.csv.

kevin: Got them. v1 matched scaled totals within 1.8% after sample scaling. Looks good.

elaine: Mapping PR ready for canary. I'll apply to 10% of traffic in staging, monitor for 15m, then bump.

maya: Thanks team — will mark billing-worker unblock after 30m of canary stability. If anyone can't be reached, post updates here. :thumbsup:
